description: This file defines utility functions for spatial layout selection of DOM elements based on their bounding rectangles, such as determining relative positions like 'left of', 'above', or 'near'. It includes functions to calculate proximity scores between elements.

methods.name: function boxRightOf(box1: DOMRect, box2: DOMRect, maxDistance: number | undefined): number | und/ boxRightOf
methods.description: Calculates the distance of element box1 to the right of box2 if within maxDistance; returns undefined otherwise.

methods.name: function boxLeftOf(box1: DOMRect, box2: DOMRect, maxDistance: number | undefined): number | unde/ boxLeftOf
methods.description: Calculates the distance of element box1 to the left of box2 if within maxDistance; returns undefined otherwise.

methods.name: function boxAbove(box1: DOMRect, box2: DOMRect, maxDistance: number | undefined): number | undef/ boxAbove
methods.description: Calculates the vertical distance of element box1 above box2 if within maxDistance; returns undefined otherwise.

methods.name: function boxBelow(box1: DOMRect, box2: DOMRect, maxDistance: number | undefined): number | undef/ boxBelow
methods.description: Calculates the vertical distance of element box1 below box2 if within maxDistance; returns undefined otherwise.

methods.name: function boxNear(box1: DOMRect, box2: DOMRect, maxDistance: number | undefined): number | undefi/ boxNear
methods.description: Computes a closeness score between boxes based on their positions; returns undefined if the score exceeds threshold.

methods.name: export function layoutSelectorScore(name: LayoutSelectorName, element: Element, inner: Element[]/ layoutSelectorScore
methods.description: Evaluates the best matching score for a specified spatial relation ('left-of', 'above', etc.) between an element and a list of inner elements.
